scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @bimik/shared-types && npm run build -w @bimik/validation
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:packages && npm run db:migrate -w @bimik/api
scripts.db:normalize-roles: npm run build:packages && npm run db:normalize-roles -w @bimik/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bimik/shared-types && npm run build -w @bimik/validation && npm run build -w @bimik/api && npm run build -w @bimik/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bimik/shared-types && npm run build -w @bimik/validation && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
